description: Read one HelloFresh delivery week: delivery date and slot, meal-pick cutoff, status, box size, the meals currently picked (with any premium upcharge), allowed actions, alternative delivery days, and the box price — HelloFresh’s own checkout total plus the picked meals’ premium upcharge, or a labelled local estimate when that cannot be read.

box_number.description: This box’s number, counting every box ever delivered — overrides the number derived from next_box_number. Only used by the local estimate (when HelloFresh’s price cannot be read).

next_box_number.description: Which box this account’s NEXT running delivery will be, counting every box ever delivered (1 = the first box). The voucher’s discount depends on it. Default: 1 when HelloFresh says the first box is not delivered yet; otherwise an assumed 2 (HelloFresh does not say how many boxes were delivered).

view.description: Response shape: "compact" (default) drops fields the response already carries elsewhere; "full" returns every field this server understands. compact keeps the essentials; full adds every allowlisted field (prices, slot handle, sub-status) and, for an estimate, every estimate field.

week.description: The delivery week as an ISO week, e.g. 2026-W49 (from hf_list_deliveries).

name: hf_get_delivery
